goal: Prevent fee estimation errors and severe underbidding when the mempool estimator is unready
Ensure wallets receive valid fee estimates by falling back to block policy during startup
agreement: Broad support for falling back to block policy when mempool estimates are unavailable
Verified by testing that the change fixes failed fee rate estimates (tankyleo)
Nonblocking objection: wrapping error returns in helper functions obscures call sites (davidgumberg)
Unaddressed concern: stale estimator data during IBD catch-up could degrade accuracy (l0rinc)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it prevents fee estimator queries from erroring or underbidding fees during cold starts
Downstream applications and lightning nodes avoid underpriced transactions when mempool is unready
